full_page.content:
Page 17 Jan.
9 Charles Easten - 43 - bleeding ulcers of stomach - given up Dec. 3rd last - at time when he was taking blood transfusion - enrolled in Ser. Mass A. and prayers. Now back to work - ask for prayers of thanksgiving for himself and family of three
10 Mrs. Mary Gillis - 47 - 2nd Stroke on Jan. 2nd - yesterday a week - unconscious most of time since. Drs. say she has clott on brain and some have refused to see her any more; has five children hoping and praying for her recover with husband - Enrolled 2nd time To-day as perpetual mem.
Jan. 12th Paul Schultz - 68 - stomach cance. has large family - 12 - rather hopeless outlook .... We'll hope anyhow. is enrolled again To-day - $5.
Frank Winke - 41 - extremely nerveous. has wife and tw children Jean Bach of Minneapolis - 11 brok arm 2nd time in two years - had asthma formerly and had prayers ... was helped ... that this should happen
Page 18
Gilbert Kullen - 22 - non Cath. - father was C. - pneumonia Katherine Madeja ... out of work
Jos. Brisson - 60 - stroke two months ago - still unable to talk, tho conscious and able to take nourishment
John Livingston - 37 - has had two operations for stomach ulcers: is to have examination at 2:PM Today : has been sick since Xmas - has wife and three small children
John Walter Jachimowicz - 24 - fitz
Maxwell Spreen - noncal.
Cath. Watermatman
James & Leo Ross - 28 - 33 - drinking - neglect widowed mother .... Mrs. B. J. Harris - 50 - Gall - trouble
Mrs. Mary D. Trump - about 40 - cancer of breast going away. some months ago given up as "doomed", improving every day. . .. Thanks. . !
